The Astro Fair is just around the corner!

 The Nanosatellite Research Laboratory invites visitors to engage with issues of space sustainability through hands-on arts-based activities. Participants will think about how we can take care of our space environment, to learn about space situational awareness research, and to hold real satellite components.

More information on our Partner, it can be found here: https://nanosatellite.lab.yorku.ca/
